app-1174180.reason: This game draws through Vulkan or Direct3D 12, which only the Vulkan layer runs, so it keeps Vulkan even when Settings chooses DXMT for every game.

app-292030.reason: The current build reserves 64 GB and 32 GB of address space at start, more than an iPhone app has, so it gets the first 6 GB of each and is told it got all of it. Its render thread waits for work in a busy loop; here that loop lets the core rest, which leaves more of the phone's power for the game (about 9 % more frames per second once the phone is warm).

epic-Buffalo.reason: This game draws nothing on a screen wider than 16:9.
